answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the hollow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. Work waits on the horizon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sable of the next round.
